panels.title: Search Traces in Explore
panels.description: Grafana's Jaeger panel requires a specific Trace ID. Use Explore for search-based trace browsing with waterfall view.

options.content:
### Trace Search

Open **Explore** to search traces by service, operation, tags, and duration:

- [go-notify](/explore?schemaVersion=1&panes=%7B%22one%22%3A%7B%22datasource%22%3A%22victoriatraces%22%2C%22queries%22%3A%5B%7B%22refId%22%3A%22A%22%2C%22queryType%22%3A%22search%22%2C%22service%22%3A%22go-notify%22%2C%22limit%22%3A20%7D%5D%7D%7D)
- [go-schwab-auth](/explore?schemaVersion=1&panes=%7B%22one%22%3A%7B%22datasource%22%3A%22victoriatraces%22%2C%22queries%22%3A%5B%7B%22refId%22%3A%22A%22%2C%22queryType%22%3A%22search%22%2C%22service%22%3A%22go-schwab-auth%22%2C%22limit%22%3A20%7D%5D%7D%7D)
- [go-telemetry-mesh](/explore?schemaVersion=1&panes=%7B%22one%22%3A%7B%22datasource%22%3A%22victoriatraces%22%2C%22queries%22%3A%5B%7B%22refId%22%3A%22A%22%2C%22queryType%22%3A%22search%22%2C%22service%22%3A%22go-telemetry-mesh%22%2C%22limit%22%3A20%7D%5D%7D%7D)

Click a trace ID in the results to open the waterfall view.

panels.title: Trace Lookup by ID
panels.description: Paste a trace ID to view the full span waterfall

options.content:
### Cross-Signal Navigation

**Logs with Traces**
- [go-notify errors](/d/victorialogs-explorer?var-namespace=namespace:schwab-ddowell&var-level=level:error&var-filter=service:go-notify)
- [go-schwab-auth errors](/d/victorialogs-explorer?var-namespace=namespace:schwab-ddowell&var-level=level:error&var-filter=service:go-schwab-auth)

**Service Dashboards**
- [Service / RED Overview](/d/service-red)

**Trace-to-Logs**

When viewing a trace waterfall above, click **Logs for this span** to jump to VictoriaLogs filtered by trace ID.

---

*The `trace_id` field in logs enables bidirectional linking between logs and traces.*

### Service Map Not Yet Available

The service dependency graph requires **cross-service trace propagation**. Currently, each Go service produces independent traces without shared trace context.

**To enable:**
1. Add W3C `traceparent` header propagation between services
2. Ensure HTTP clients inject and servers extract trace context
3. Once inter-service spans share trace IDs, the dependency graph will populate automatically
